description: Industry-Specific Software '24: Legal & Professional Services Software backdrop — FRED BFS + PCE legal spend + corporate profits + BLS legal/professional employment + legal PPI. No prediction markets in v1.

series.label: Business Applications: Total for All NAICS in the United States
series.official_name: FRED BABATOTALSAUS — Business Formation Statistics: Business Applications Total SA
series.notes: Top-of-funnel formation demand for LegalZoom / transactional legal software.

series.label: Personal Consumption Expenditures: Legal Services
series.official_name: FRED DGALRC1A027NBEA — Personal Consumption Expenditures: Legal Services (BEA DGALRC; watch alias PCESLS)
series.display_name: US consumer spending on legal services
series.notes: Direct legal-services demand proxy (RELX Legal / research & practice software). Watchlists often cite PCESLS; FRED series id is DGALRC1A027NBEA (annual).

series.label: Corporate Profits After Tax (without IVA and CCAdj)
series.official_name: FRED CPATAX — Corporate Profits After Tax without IVA and CCAdj
series.notes: Soft budget proxy for corporate legal / risk / compliance software spend. Noisier than PCE legal or employment.

series.label: All Employees: Legal Services
series.official_name: BLS CES6054110001 — All Employees, Thousands, SA: Legal Services (NAICS 5411)
series.notes: Seat / billable professional base for legal research, practice management, and litigation software.

series.label: All Employees: Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
series.official_name: BLS CES6054000001 — All Employees, Thousands, SA: Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services (NAICS 54)
series.notes: Broader NAICS 54 headcount for accounting/consulting software (Intapp, Wolters Kluwer).

series.label: PPI Industry: Offices of Lawyers
series.official_name: BLS PCU541110541110 — Producer Price Index by Industry: Offices of Lawyers
series.notes: Realization / pricing power — headroom for premium legal AI and practice software.
